what_matters.head: Chip stocks bounced on Friday after their worst sell-off since 2020: the chip fund rose 3.5% and AMD 11%.
what_matters.detail: Yahoo Finance said the chip index rose about 4% after Thursday's 12% fall, as investors weighed what a Democratic Congress means for data-centre building. Yardeni Research called Thursday's sell-off an overreaction. The October jobs report was much stronger than expected: 165,000 jobs added against about 65,000 in Bloomberg's survey, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. The two months before were revised up by a combined 84,000. Yahoo Finance said the report firmed up expectations that the Fed raises rates in December.

what_matters.head: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation after reports that chief executive Jensen Huang was the target of a Chinese intelligence effort.
what_matters.detail: In a memo to staff on 8 Nov, Huang admitted an extramarital affair and said he would cooperate. A company spokesperson said Huang will keep leading Nvidia without interruption (Yahoo Finance). Nvidia had filed nothing with the SEC about it by 10 Nov (EDGAR). Nvidia fell as much as 8% after Monday's open, then pared the fall, while other chip stocks rose. The chip fund was up nearly 5% early Monday (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance). None of this is in Friday's US prices.

what_matters.head: US October CPI is out at 21:30 SGT Tuesday, and CoreWeave reports about 05:05 SGT Wednesday.
what_matters.detail: September's CPI was 3.7% higher than a year earlier. CoreWeave's own forecast for Q3 revenue is $3.4–3.6B, and options trading implies a move of about ±21.1% either way by 13 Nov. Reuters called CoreWeave a poster child for investor worries about AI profitability and debt. TSMC's October sales (13:30 SGT) and Infineon's results (14:30 SGT) come earlier on Tuesday.

latest.tape_note: On Friday the chip fund rose 3.5% after Thursday's 12.2% fall, and the Nasdaq 100 fund rose 1.4%. The S&P 500 fund rose 0.3%. Over the week the chip fund was down 13.1%, the Nasdaq 100 fund 5.0% and the S&P 500 fund 2.7%. VIX fell 9%. The 10-year yield rose 2 basis points to 4.86%. The dollar index rose 0.7%, about 2.4 times its usual daily move, and the US dollar rose 0.4% against the Singapore dollar. US crude rose 0.3% and gold fell 0.9%.
latest.tonight: Tuesday: TSMC's October sales at 13:30 SGT and Infineon's results at 14:30 SGT. US October CPI is out at 21:30 SGT. CoreWeave reports after the New York close, about 05:05 SGT Wednesday.

recent.headline: Chip stocks bounced on Friday after their worst sell-off since 2020: the chip fund rose 3.5% and AMD 11%.
Wall Street's AI stocks sold off hard: the S&P 500 fund fell 4.4%, about 6.6 times its usual daily move, and the chip fund 12.2%.
Wall Street rose after the Democratic sweep, led by Microsoft and Amazon, while chip and data-centre stocks fell.
The AP projects that Democrats win both the House and the Senate, and US stock futures and Asian chip stocks fell on it.
Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal, and Lumentum fell 18.6%, about 3.4 times its usual daily move.
